Fulltext acquisition uses DOI/OA metadata first. For English or international papers, OpenAlex/Crossref/Unpaywall/Semantic Scholar are the batch OA attempt; if no verified PDF is acquired, Google Scholar exact-title lookup and right-side PDF links become the default per-paper fallback. The official Zotero plugin is used for library search, BibTeX export, citation keys, and explicit attachment/import planning. CNKI discovery/download defaults to envctl cnki-zotero and authorized Chrome/CDP rather than direct cnki-mcp activation. Browser selectors, local smoke-test status, and captcha checkpoint rules are governed by scholar_browser_patterns.json.
